name: AI Utilities
summary: Author and vet Claude Code extensions (skill-creator, skill-review) and close the plan-to-implementation loop (plan-completion-audit, audit-resolver).

instructions: Use the plugin from the local ai-utilities directory.
Codex discovers this plugin through .agents/plugins/marketplace.json at the johns-os root.
audit-resolver applies code fixes and gates every fix behind explicit confirmation; plan-completion-audit is read-only and writes a report.
Validate with python scripts/johns-os-marketplace.py validate before use.
